```{r message = F}
library(tidyverse)
set.seed(311)

# simulate data
theta_true <- 4
n <- 20
x <- rpois(n, theta_true)

# mechanism for assessing convergence
flag <- TRUE
eps <- 0.00000001
```

```{r eval = F}
# visualize
theta_mle <- ____ # replace with mle
data.frame(theta_est = ____) |> # replace with vector of approx
  mutate(iteration = row_number()) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = iteration, y = theta_est)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = theta_mle, linetype = "dashed")

```
